assets.prompt: BRINE underwater station-builder environment decal. Square native image. One low irregular sediment scour mark viewed directly overhead orthographically: shallow crescent of displaced grey-beige fine silt with two short broken trailing streaks and tiny sparse grit, as if a heavy object slid a short distance over the seabed. Quiet natural tactile game-art material, very shallow relief, muted grey-brown palette, diffuse neutral lighting. Asymmetric open horseshoe-like smear but not a perfect geometric crescent or ring, ragged broken ends, mostly empty center, soft translucent dusty perimeter. True RGBA transparent background everywhere outside the sediment mark and through gaps, partially transparent fine grains at edges. No object, rock pile, footprint, tire tracks, crater, deep hole, cast shadow, rectangular ground patch, water splash, bubbles, text, glow or horizon. Entire mark centered with generous transparent margin. Reusable static ground decal intended beneath small wreckage at less than one room-cell width. No implied active digging effect.
